assets.caption: The scene is a magnificent open red sandstone desert canyon at golden sunset, rendered in a photorealistic cinematic science fiction frontier style. The overall tone is awe-inspiring and vast, evoking a sense of ancient grandeur and subtle mystery. Monument Valley-scale sheer stratified orange cliffs and eroded arches tower majestically on both sides of a broad, winding, dry sandy riverbed. These colossal rock formations display intricate wind-carved patterns, showcasing millennia of natural erosion. Warm sunlight bathes the scene, illuminating dust motes suspended in the air, creating a soft, ethereal glow. In the far distance, flat-topped mesas rise from the desert floor, adding layers of depth to the expansive landscape. The sky above transitions from a deep blue at the zenith to soft peach hues near the horizon, reflecting the golden hour. Subtly integrated between distant cliffs are abandoned industrial blast doors, hinting at a forgotten past or a hidden future within this natural wonder. The foreground consists of open, empty, flat sandy ground, stretching out to meet the towering geological features.
